notes: Sequential fresh four-worker Linux servers; default 4 KiB reads and 32 MiB queue bytes, max(1024, producers * cycles + 32) queue messages, 60s write deadline, heartbeats and rates disabled. A 64 KiB requested client receive buffer and eight 1 MiB fillers establish unread transport backpressure. Synchronized producers alternate large unknown-target primers with tiny queued values and verified self barriers. Each producer's full sequence is verified without imposing a cross-producer order. Optional connected-idle sampling follows complete drain; two seconds of retired sampling follow client-initiated or required server-idle Close handshakes. Server-only RSS/CPU and relevant queue/routing metrics sampled about every 50ms, all final counters retained. Each case caps primer traffic at 8 GiB; preparation is bounded independently of traffic. Extra server arguments are recorded verbatim. Samples spanning a client phase marker are labeled transition and excluded from stable phase ranges. No leak or production-capacity claim.
